title: Randomized Trial of Ciprofloxacin Versus Observation for Men With Elevated Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the impact of an empiric course of antibiotics for men with an elevated prostate-specific antigen (PSA) level.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men 18 yrs. or older
* An elevated PSA (\>2.5 ng/ml) and normal digital rectal exam
* Have elected to proceed with a diagnostic 12-core prostate biopsy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous prostate biopsy
* History of prostate cancer
* Urinary tract infections or prostatitis within one year of study entry
* antibiotic use within one month prior to PSA level
* pyuria or bacteruria on urinalysis
* allergy to fluoroquinolones
